title: Sections supported on a closed subset with retrocompact complement form a quasi-coherent sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter properties.tex (Properties of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file properties.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a closed subset Z of a scheme X with retrocompact complement and a quasi-coherent module F, the subsheaf of sections supported on Z is described on affine opens by annihilation by a power of a finitely generated ideal and is quasi-coherent (statement lines 4051-4072). The proof (proof lines 4074-4108) uses the finitely generated ideal on affine opens, translates the support condition through the support lemma, and identifies the sheaf as the kernel of a map to a quasi-coherent pushforward. H2: three parts with three inputs, written out in full.
